fields.description: Vista Ridge brings one to three bedroom apartments and three bedroom townhouses to Emaar South. Its two apartment buildings sit beside the community’s golf landscape. The official plans offer a useful range of balcony and terrace sizes, with the townhouses arranged over two levels rather than marketed as penthouses.

overview: The brochure places Vista Ridge within an 18-hole golf-course community. Interiors are presented with stone and timber textures and muted natural colours. Pools, play spaces and exercise facilities support day-to-day life beyond the apartment. Golf access, views and finishes should be checked for the selected home rather than assumed from a rendering.
research.locationNote: Emaar South is part of Dubai South, near Al Maktoum International Airport. The brochure map shows Emirates Road and the airport’s surrounding road network. Its journey times are marketing estimates; test the actual route for your commute and the chosen building entrance.
research.priceNote: Emaar displays units from AED 2,614,888 while also retaining an earlier starting-price statement of AED 1.2 million. The unit figure is used as the dated reference here. It does not establish the cheapest remaining home or a guaranteed offer.
research.paymentNote: Property Finder reports 10% at launch booking, 70% during construction and 20% on handover. These are reported project terms, not a developer payment quotation for a new reservation. Obtain a dated unit-specific schedule before committing.
research.handoverNote: Property Finder gives September 2029; Bayut’s tower references give Q3 2029. These agree, but the reviewed official documents do not establish a contractual completion date.
